//optionalDependencies: MEM-4 (PLAN-MEMORY.md §6.1): @huggingface/transformers powers local semantic memory search, reached only through a computed-specifier dynamic import in memory-embed.ts (never a static import — see that file's header) so its absence degrades to Ollama→lexical and never breaks the `bun build --compile` single-binary (docs/RELEASE-BUNDLING.md — zero native deps). Declared HERE, not on packages/daemon, because pnpm's non-hoisted node_modules resolves a bare specifier relative to the physical location of the file performing the import — declaring it only on a sibling package (daemon) left packages/core/node_modules without the symlink and the dynamic import failed with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND every time, silently degrading semantic search to lexical.
